pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against stacking multiple 0.01 lots within a 60-second window; mandatory spacing of at least 50 ticks and a confirmed breakout candle closure before scaling.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume-weighted order flow confirmation and a 5-period ATR volatility check; no entries permitted if current candle ATR exceeds 3x the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop-lock once floating profit hits +$6.00 to guarantee net positive yield and prevent evaporation.
